mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to reduced risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the mean of the preceding 30 months (p > 0.05) during tightening phases.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 50,000 jobs and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be positive due to labor market strength.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, returns are not significantly above the 6-month pre-trigger average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 (2017=100) combined with a decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL < 242) predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as supply outpaces demand pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative or flat despite the signal (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the GDPC1 (real GDP) growth rate below -1% is associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates economic softening.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly below the prior 30-day average (p > 0.05) during slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as the market expects future rate cuts.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (IC < 0.1) during deflationary periods.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4% and the labor force participation rate (HOUST) rises above 62%, the S&P 500 shows a positive 60-day forward return reflecting optimism about labor market tightness.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not statistically superior to a neutral benchmark (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in retail sales proxy (not available in the catalog; fallback: use PAYEMS as a proxy for consumption) combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO > 110) signals demand expansion and positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are flat or negative despite the pattern (IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as supply contraction outweighs demand pressures.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (IC > -0.05) during contractionary episodes.
